title: Rig Relay Context Capsule v1
description: Compact, content-light context capsule consumed by Y3 agent context assembly. Provides a freshness-checkable summary derived from the repository context release suitable for fast agent context assembly without re-indexing.

capsule_id.description: Unique identifier for this context capsule.

repository_root.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

released_context_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the RepositoryContextRelease this capsule derives from.

instruction_scope_text_length.description: Deferred to future slice — currently always null. Will sum instruction file content character lengths across all discovered files.

module_count.description: Total number of modules in the structural index.

symbol_count.description: Total number of symbols in the structural index.

safe_commands.description: Admitted safe validation commands available for agent use.

restrictions.description: Human-readable runtime restrictions inherited from context release.

fresh.description: Deferred to future slice — currently always null. Will reflect capsule freshness relative to latest context release.

stale_since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this capsule became stale, or null if fresh.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this capsule was generated.

capsule_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the canonical capsule JSON.
